about: The zoo's education team runs the evening, which explains animal enrichment and why it keeps zoo animals active and engaged.
Guests make a gift of enrichment for an animal ambassador or another zoo resident, so kids leave knowing their gift went to a real animal.
The zoo's agenda has doors at 5:45 pm, the animal encounter until 7 pm, enrichment making from 6 to 7:30 pm and Wild Lights at 7:30 pm.
Each adult ticket includes a ceramic commemorative ornament.
faq: When is Christmas with the Critters at Cameron Park Zoo?
December 17 to 23, 2026. Doors open at 5:45 pm at 1701 N. 4th St.
How much are tickets?
$35 for adults and $25 for children ages 3 to 13, according to the zoo. Each adult ticket includes a ceramic ornament.
What is included?
An animal encounter, enrichment gift making, hot cocoa and cookies, admission to Wild Lights and a commemorative ornament.
What time does Wild Lights start?
The zoo's agenda lists entrance to Wild Lights at 7:30 pm.
How do I buy tickets?
The zoo sells tickets for this program through its online ticket page linked from the event page.

about: Art Center Waco calls this its last free Family Day of 2026.
The morning mixes art with extras like face painting and visiting rescue dogs.
The center also previews its 2027 art classes, special events and Summer Camp: Art Through the Eras.
faq: When is ACW Family Day: Winter Wonderland?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 am to 1 pm at Art Center Waco, 701 S. 8th St.
Is Winter Wonderland free?
Yes. Art Center Waco calls it a free Family Day.
What is there for kids to do?
Face painting, hot chocolate with marshmallows, rescue dogs, live artist demonstrations and hands-on art activities.
Is this the last Family Day this year?
Yes, the center calls it the last free Family Day of 2026.
Who can come?
The center says the activities are for the whole family.
